// Safety check\n\n    // Formula: Score = 0.7 * Score + 0.3 * (P * W)\n    // We utilize the existing mab_reward array to store the EMA scores.\n    double current_score = solver-\u003emab_reward[h];\n    double new_score = 0.7 * current_score + 0.3 * (P * W);\n    solver-\u003emab_reward[h] = new_score;\n\n    // --- Step 4: Determine Next Mode (Heuristic) ---\n    \n    // Update stagnation counter based on progress\n    if (W \u003e 1.0) {\n        stagnation_count = 0;
